smyx-elderly-loneliness-depression-analysis 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for AI-based detection of loneliness and depression behavioral signals in elderly individuals using fixed home cameras.
- Automatically identifies and counts dazing, sighing, and self-talking events during solo periods, then evaluates overall emotional risk (low/medium/high).
- Generates daily emotional risk reports and pushes reminders when elevated risk is detected.
- Designed for integration in home-care cameras, nursing homes, and community health-management platforms.
- Enforces strict open-id acquisition before analysis or report access, with privacy and data source controls.
- Includes multi-language support (Chinese/English) and provides structured, actionable alerts for caregivers or community workers.
